cocycle_status: coassociative constant 1-cocycle only after level-exchange naturality; magnitude remains free
theorem: Three sequential binary refinements form an associative Kronecker sum with three rates. Naturality under the complete S3 permutation of indistinguishable refinement levels forces all three rates equal. The resulting constant rate composes consistently and may be read as a one-parameter scale cocycle, but its magnitude is not selected.
